description: 中區水資源分署轄管水庫堰壩洩洪訊息 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 經濟部水利署中區水資源分署轄管水庫堰壩洩洪訊息，訊息來源包含鯉魚潭水庫、石岡壩、集集攔河堰及湖山水庫，於堰、壩有排洪、排砂、調節水量等需求，需要開啟閘門或水庫自然溢流情形發生時，公告相關訊息，提醒下游低窪地區民眾注意防範。 由經濟部水利署中區水資源分署提供，中區水資源分署主管台灣中部地區水資源工程規劃、設計、施工，與所轄鯉魚潭水庫、石岡壩... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
